cleaning_decisions.method: Mode-fill with constant 'unknown_legacy' (not 'organic' — would bias channel comparisons)
cleaning_decisions.business_logic_check: Imputing with the mode 'organic' would conflate paid/organic attribution; a separate 'unknown_legacy' bucket preserves the gap.
cleaning_decisions.reasoning: These are pre-2021 records where the channel attribution column did not exist. Treating them as a separate cohort preserves the analytical integrity of Phase 4's channel-segmented churn rates.

cleaning_decisions.issue: Free-text values in 2.1% of pre-2023 rows
cleaning_decisions.method: Regex-map common phrases (case-insensitive 'card decline' / 'cc failed' → payment_failed; 'switched plan' → downgrade); residue → 'other'.
cleaning_decisions.business_logic_check: Voluntary vs payment-failure distinction is the key separator Phase 5 will test; misclassifying these would inflate the voluntary-churn baseline.
cleaning_decisions.reasoning: Standardisation preserves the row, retains the analytical signal, and is explicitly justified by Phase 1's success_definition (drivers of voluntary churn).

cleaning_decisions.issue: camelCase ↔ snake_case duplicate names from the 2023 taxonomy migration
cleaning_decisions.method: Apply mapping table from the engineering taxonomy doc; lowercase + snake_case as canonical form.
cleaning_decisions.business_logic_check: Phase 1 SQ2 (behaviour–churn association) requires unified event names; otherwise feature_used and featureUsed would be counted as separate features and dilute the signal.
cleaning_decisions.reasoning: This is a CRITICAL anomaly because untreated it would silently halve the effect size in Phase 5. Standardisation is reversible (we keep the raw column); imputation/drop are inappropriate here.

cleaning_decisions.method: Drop users.email from the analysis extract entirely; if hashed identity is needed downstream, derive a SHA-256(email + project_salt) column instead.
cleaning_decisions.business_logic_check: Email is not needed to compute any Phase 1 KPI; dropping it removes the PII risk with zero analytical cost.
cleaning_decisions.reasoning: DROP_COLUMN over hash because there is no downstream use case that requires re-identification; Phase 2 governance_flags already mandates mitigation.

feature_engineering.rationale: Phase 1 KPI 'first-30-day behaviour vs 90-day churn' requires a fixed-window tenure variable; derived once here so Phase 4 can reuse.
feature_engineering.validation_check: tenure_days ≥ 0 for every row; max ≤ 2200 (longest subscription in 5 years of data).

feature_engineering.formula: CASE WHEN cancel_reason = 'payment_failed' THEN 'involuntary' WHEN end_date IS NULL THEN 'active' ELSE 'voluntary' END
feature_engineering.rationale: Phase 1 A2 assumption: voluntary vs involuntary churn must be analysed separately.
feature_engineering.validation_check: Distribution: roughly 65% active, 22% voluntary, 13% involuntary; outside this range → investigate before Phase 4.

change_log.reason: Preserve cohort integrity per Phase 1 channel-segmented analysis.

change_log.transformation: Regex standardisation of free-text values to enum
change_log.reason: Phase 5 voluntary-vs-payment-failure test requires clean enum values.

change_log.reason: Critical anomaly fix; required for SQ2 behaviour analysis.
PII; not needed for any KPI per Phase 2 governance_flags.

validation_suite.notes: Row loss is from de-duplicating 2296 exact-duplicate subscription rows created by a 2024-08 retry loop in the billing system.

risks_found: Imputing acquisition_channel as 'unknown_legacy' could under-represent paid channels' historical performance if many of those NULLs were genuinely paid.
Standardising cancel_reason via regex may misclassify rare free-text values, slightly biasing toward 'voluntary' if the regex is too narrow.
bias_audit.mitigation: Phase 5 should treat 'unknown_legacy' as its own segment when reporting effect sizes; Phase 8 should disclose the regex-standardisation rule in the Caveats section.
